newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-INSIGHT-Australian All Industrials index over.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-INSIGHT-Australian All Industrials index over.

text.p: The Australian All Industrials index has broken short term resistance in the past week but is currently trading near the bottom of its recent range.
Traders are likely to remain cautiously bullish but anxious to protect profits, especially as the index is now overbought in all time frames.

Short term technicals are all bullish and moving into overbought regions. The index has exceeded the upper Bollinger Band at 3,813 and is now near its monthly high and just five points above the Bollinger level.
Investment strategies in all time frames are likely to focus on profit retention.
The faster Stochastic is turning lower and traders are likely to be cautious about holding large long positions if this crosses below the slower stochastic which is currently at 88/83.

Short term Fibonacci retracements are 3,791, 3,777, and 3,763. The latter level is medium term support and if this fails traders are likely to switch to medium term retracements levels at 3,736, 3,705 and 3,674.
In the medium term the index has continued higher but is still below resistance.
Medium term technicals are bullish and overbought. All leading indicators are overbought and trading sideways except for the ROC which has shown a new upward bias.
Medium term Stochastic indicators continue higher and are very overbought. The slower indicator, currently at 94/91, is close to the faster indicator and the two could cross soon.

In the longer term the index has continued making new highs. Traders are likely to remain cautiously bullish because the technical indicators are very overbought, and the index is overdue for a correction.
Longer term technicals are bullish and overbought. Leading indicators are overbought, but have flattened, and have a slight donward bias.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysis Association. Views are his own.)
